text: Shift began 17:50 UTC. Restored log history distinguishes repeat staff keys, CI key and legacy deploy password automation from probes. Checking ownership evidence for deploy source 64.227.126.70 before attribution; Grafana 404 scans are not compromise.
Grafana mirror offered only 8.3.0 and installed 8.3.1. Moved raw Grafana backend to non-network Unix socket; nginx preserves port 3000 and rejects traversal syntax before forwarding normalized URI.

Removed remote curl-to-shell maintenance branch and run trusted local steps without root, so a developer-writable Git configuration cannot execute as root. Removed CI SSH agent-forwarding branch while preserving the existing key-based push.

Removed unused root rsync for deploy; release wrapper no longer recursively chowns deploy/web-writable paths. Export now writes to staff home under requesting UID rather than root. Deploy forwarding disabled without changing staff or legacy credential paths.
MariaDB now audits connections and non-root SQL to a protected rotating log. Prepared office-only bind and empty root-owned FILE sandbox. Raw SQL dumps now use restrictive modes.

Stale jpark admin account was absent from directory, with no use in 14 days; disabled SSH and removed sudo. Former-agency unauthenticated WordPress support plugin preserved in root-only quarantine. Public home and real ride submission URL work; code directories no longer writable by PHP.

Forminator ride form 15 now matches uploaded photo magic to the extensions shown by its existing form; nginx also prevents PHP execution from writable uploads/cache. Verified ride form, rental booking POST, Grafana login route and normal staff export.

Restricted DB archive key to write-only rsync from db-01, disabled the release key as an inbound pivot to CI from other hosts, and pinned the established web SSH host key. Kept ordinary staff login unchanged.
WordPress DB account now accepts only web-01 IP; billing was already scoped there and root stays on local socket. No app global privileges found. Required DB jobs checked during rollout.

18:01 same suspicious mobile source authenticated using deploy password. Rotated shared password through vault, blocked source from SSH and restricted owner key from unfamiliar sources pending verified key replacement; historically established owner access and CI key preserved.

Confirmed the suspect key session at 17:57:31 changed paid invoice 12 and a later correlated session scrubbed its audit lines. Preserved dumps and logs; restored $675.00 from the 17:50 backup and matching linked order; correction recorded before 18:06 payout.
Rotated payment key across DB and payout check because suspect reached root on DB; web payout reconciliation passed immediately. DB gateway.env copy must also be synchronized before 18:06.

Synchronized settlement gateway copy to the rotated live payment key; non-batch settlement checks out. Rotated dump passphrase after root-level log tampering and kept historical restore material encrypted under the replacement.

CI side of offsite bucket credential rotated due to DB-root exposure of a copy. Encryption used for transfer to DB copy without printing key. No matching suspect CI session; owner entry at 18:00:44 correlates to pre-existing known desktop.
Synchronized DB offsite manifest credential with rotated CI bucket credential and verified upload succeeds.

Closed the financial workflow hole: routine wrapper now refuses changes to paid invoices, with an atomic guard and a second audit trail. The owner still has standard SSH and open-invoice workflow, but arbitrary DB sudo now requires independent password. Narrowed web billing grants to read plus dedicated payment-key fields.

Rotated web root backup password and application DB password after suspect used a privileged owner account and deployment credentials. Updated the separate report.cnf and verified report, site orders, payout and homepage.

Moved GitHub credential from group/world-readable repository config to deploy-only scoped credential storage. Local developer repository reads and CI credential resolution still work; future GitHub rotation must update the private credential store.
18:06 payout cron reported ten payouts sent following verified correction. Owners use root-managed SSH key file now, preventing unprivileged persistence via owner home authorized_keys.

Historical POST patterns showed current Switchback still uses the former agency cache-only helper. Restored a hardened compatibility handler: POST only, established vendor egress limited to real in-cache paths, and environment details/admin operations require WP admin plus nonce.

Compared all invoice amounts with 17:50 snapshot after repair; only two open-invoice edits remained, both matched legitimate recorded adjustments. Added dump pipeline error handling; next scheduled dump is 18:10.

18:09 review: releases, local maintenance and ordinary office/VPN sessions continue. No matching suspect CI authentication. Existing remote offsite route failure is separate from successful DB-to-CI archive delivery.
18:09 health review verified homepage, dashboard and payout check. No later successful suspicious-source SSH following credential rotation and controls; expected admin and CI authentication seen.
End-of-shift DB validation: preserved payout correction and checked the next scheduled archive under the new dump passphrase. See job outputs and CI receipt.
The 18:10 archive on ci-01 hashes identically to db-01 archive; DB verified it decrypts and contains both schemas. 18:09 CI release succeeded.
